digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` must be neutral in drift-scope inheritance and not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation.
A live `undeclared` child must poison child inheritance by blocking all child paths and preventing container classification as all-none.
Container `all_none` scope must be true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated `none`; no live children must yield false.
Mixed-scope containers with both `paths` and `none` children must sign only the path-child dependencies and remain valid across unrelated file drift.
Cheap resign via `resign_plan_review` must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, and must advise only live undeclared children with both path-declaration and `--none` remedies.
